name: The Deepwater Sinks
walls: Damp brick vaulting choked with moss and slick sewage channels.
floors: Slippery moss-covered stone walkways running alongside foul sludge channels.
ceilings: Low arched brickwork sweating with condensation and dripping dirty water.
Monster (random creature): Black Pudding | Otyugh | Rot Grub | Rat
description: The uppermost subterranean level serves as Deepwater's runoff system, divided by an active gang war. The thieves guild operates out of fortified alcoves, attempting to clear out aggressive kobold tribes claiming the lower sluices. Wild beasts and scavenger oozes thrive in the filth between their territories, feeding on the casualties of their violent skirmishes.

name: The Sunless Quarries
walls: Chiseled limestone cavern walls showing raw pickaxe marks and natural pale stone veins.
floors: Uneven cracked limestone covered in fine grey dust and scattered gravel.
ceilings: Rough jagged cavern ceilings showing ancient stalactite stumps and miner timber supports.
description: Carved out during the original founding of Deepwater, these abandoned quarry caves have been reclaimed by goblin tribes. The goblins mine dangerous glowing fungi while fending off subterranean predators that crawl up from deeper fissures. Adventurers often pass through here using old mining shafts to reach the deeper forgotten ruins below.

name: The Silent Catacombs
walls: Rows of dusty stone ossuary niches filled with ancient skulls and weathered funerary bas-reliefs.
floors: Smooth polished black flagstones lined with faded runic inlaid brass.
ceilings: Vaulted stone archways adorned with faded burial murals and cobwebs.
description: An ancient necropolis predating Deepwater itself, housing the remains of long-dead nobility and lost legions. Awoken by dark necromantic energy seeping from below, undead sentinels patrol the halls to enforce their eternal slumber. Grave robbers and priests alike avoid these halls due to the lethal traps and restless spirits haunting the burial vaults.

name: The Void-Vein Caverns
walls: Jagged obsidian walls glistening with purple mineral veins and bioluminescent fungi.
floors: Cracked dark granite covered in patches of pale glowing moss and subterranean mold.
ceilings: Towering naturally vaulted rock ceilings with sharp stalactites dripping dark mineral water.
Monster (dominant inhabitant): Orc Bloodwarrior | Orc Berserker | Orc Warchief
Monster (random creature): Orc Shaman | Orc Breaker | Formian Taskmaster | Gnoll Alpha
description: A subterranean wilderness where subterranean warbands clash for dominance over strategic chokepoints. Orcish warparties have established forward strongholds to fend off aggressive hive-minded insects and savage gnoll hunting packs. The air is heavy with the smell of blood, smoke, and crushed fungi, marking it as a perpetual warzone.

name: The Flesh-Forge Laboratories
walls: Stained white marble tiles splashed with chemical residue and lined with rusting iron piping.
floors: Seamless polished slate embedded with brass drain grates and alchemy stains.
ceilings: High vaulted ironwork ceilings supporting rusted chains, pulleys, and dangling cages.
description: Created centuries ago by a mad cabal of arcanists, this facility was designed to blend beast, construct, and magic into horrific war-creatures. Abandoned to their insane derro caretakers, the remaining laboratories continue to function autonomously, spawning mutated monstrosities that stalk the metal corridors. Broken containment cells and lethal automated defenses make navigating this facility exceptionally perilous.

name: The Abyssal Trench
walls: Carved basalt walls covered in alien runes that pulse with faint crimson luminescence.
floors: Smooth black glass floor reflecting the glowing veins of molten rock beneath the surface.
ceilings: Soaring cavern ceiling obscured by swirling shadows and heat haze.
Monster (dominant inhabitant): Deep Elf Swordmaster | Deep Elf Priest
description: Deep beneath the earth lies an ancient city submerged in subterranean heat and dark magic. Deep elf nobility rule over vast vault chambers filled with forgotten relics, using terrible monsters to guard their hoard. Magma fissures heat the halls, while ancient horrors lurk in the dark pools that dot the lower plazas.

name: The Astral Crucible
walls: Shifting crystalline monoliths reflecting starry, extra-planar voids instead of solid rock.
floors: Floated obsidian tiles hovering over an endless shimmering rift of arcane energy.
ceilings: An open void extending into infinite swirling cosmos and shimmering planar auroras.
Monster (random creature): Concept Elemental | Inevitable | Word Demon | Djinn | Nightmare
description: At the absolute bottom of the complex sits a shattered planar portal where the physical realm bleeds into outer dimensions. Fiends, angels, and elemental constructs wage a perpetual war over control of the gateway's core energy. Reality itself is unstable here, warping gravity and geometry for anyone daring to venture into the dimensional tear.
